apps/gmail: Procedures for the Gmail app (send, find, label, threads, drafts, etc.).
apps/google_drive: Procedures for the Google Drive app (find, upload, move, share files, etc.).
apps/google_sheets: Procedures for the Google Sheets app (rows, lookups, worksheets, updates, etc.).
apps/intercom: Procedures for the Intercom app (contacts, conversations, tickets, tags, notes, etc.).
apps/jira: Procedures for the Jira app (issues, comments, transitions, watchers, attachments, etc.).
apps/salesforce: Procedures for the Salesforce app (records, queries, opportunities, updates, etc.).
apps/slack: Procedures for the Slack app (post messages, channels, users, search, etc.).
domains/finance: Procedures and playbooks for finance-domain tasks (invoices, budgets, reporting, etc.).
domains/hr: Procedures and playbooks for hr-domain tasks (onboarding, reviews, records, etc.).
domains/marketing: Procedures and playbooks for marketing-domain tasks (campaigns, lists, content, etc.).
domains/operations: Procedures and playbooks for operations-domain tasks (logistics, scheduling, tracking, etc.).
domains/sales: Procedures and playbooks for sales-domain tasks (CRM records, pipelines, outreach, etc.).
domains/support: Procedures and playbooks for support-domain tasks (tickets, SLAs, escalations, etc.).
This is the workflow playbook for operations-domain tasks (logistics, scheduling, tracking, etc.).

This is the operating procedure for the Google Sheets app (rows, lookups, worksheets, updates, etc.).

- Open every worksheet of a spreadsheet (get_spreadsheet_by_id lists them) and read each with get_many_rows; policy/config/updates/blackout tabs override the base rules.
- Write status/label cells using the exact vocabulary in the rules or existing rows.

This is the operating procedure for the Gmail app (send, find, label, threads, drafts, etc.).

- Policy lives here often: list the inbox broadly (gmail_find_email, no narrow keyword, 50+ results) and read policy/update emails before acting. A narrow keyword search returning nothing does not mean no policy exists; check Slack and Drive next.
- Send one email per recipient when asked to notify each person. Put required tracking codes, IDs and exact source values in the body.
This is the operating procedure for the Google Drive app (find, upload, move, share files, etc.).

messages.body_plain: Solar panel cleaning crew scheduled for March 8, 6 AM - 12 PM. Roof access needed. Please notify security.

messages.body_plain: Monthly UPS battery test passed. All 4 units holding full charge. Next test scheduled March 28.

messages.body_plain: Vehicle F-207 (2024 Ford Transit) is due for 30k mile service. Schedule with Fleet Auto by March 12.

messages.body_plain: 3 new hires starting March 10. Please ensure workstations, badges, and parking passes are ready by March 7.

messages.body_plain: Confirming the updated delivery schedule: Tuesday/Thursday 6 AM - 8 AM. Loading dock 3 reserved.

messages.body_plain: All backups completed successfully. Total data: 4.2 TB. Duration: 3h 17m. No errors.

messages.body_plain: March cycle count found discrepancies in 3 SKUs: BOLT-M8x25 (-42 units), FILTER-HV13 (-7 units), GLOVE-NIT-L (+15 boxes). Investigation underway.

messages.body_plain: Shipping label printer at Dock 2 went offline. IT dispatched. Workaround: using Dock 3 printer. ETA for repair: 2 hours.

messages.body_plain: February access audit complete. 3 badges deactivated (terminations), 7 new badges issued. No anomalies detected.

messages.body_plain: Morning report: All HVAC systems nominal. Elevator B maintenance scheduled 2 PM. Parking lot sweeping completed overnight.

messages.subject: Inbound Shipment — Tracking #TRK8847291
messages.body_plain: Shipment from TrueNorth Equipment arriving March 5. 3 pallets. Please allocate dock space.

messages.subject: Safety Incident Report #SR-2026-047
messages.body_plain: Minor slip reported in warehouse aisle 7. No injury. Root cause: condensation from cooler unit. Corrective action: floor mat installed.

messages.subject: Building Management Alert — Zone 3 Humidity
messages.body_plain: Humidity in Zone 3 exceeded 65% at 11:23 AM. Dehumidifier activated. Current reading: 58%.

messages.body_plain: February fleet fuel: 4,200 gallons. Average 14.2 MPG. Vehicle F-112 flagged for 22% above average consumption.

messages.body_plain: Annual boiler inspection completed. All 3 units passed. Certificates uploaded to the compliance portal.

messages.body_plain: Proposal to upgrade 6 conference rooms with dual 75-inch displays and wireless casting. Total: $42,000. ROI payback: 18 months.

messages.subject: Vendor scorecard Q1 results
messages.body_plain: Q1 vendor scorecards posted. Top performers: Granite Supply (98/100), Summit Maintenance (95/100). 2 vendors flagged for late deliveries.

messages.subject: Meeting Confirmed: Weekly Ops Standup
messages.body_plain: Your meeting 'Weekly Ops Standup' has been confirmed for Monday March 3 at 9:00 AM PST.

messages.body_plain: 5 contractor badges expire this week. Please renew: M. Reeves, S. Chen, D. Kowalski, L. Morales, G. Thompson.

messages.body_plain: Annual fire extinguisher inspection complete. 2 units replaced (Building B, Floor 3). Full report attached.
